verdict.rationale: GitHub's docs mention a 'desktop workspace' where users can 'launch work,' 'track progress across multiple agents,' and 'review changes' (docs-8), plus a centralized control page to jump between agent sessions (docs-14), suggesting some support for multi-session tracking and diff review. However, there's no concrete description of a dedicated visual diff viewer or true side-by-side session UI, and no independent/hands-on evidence confirming this desktop experience works as described. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of the desktop app's diff-viewing UI, clear detail on running multiple sessions concurrently side-by-side, and hands-on user reports of this workflow.
